title: Reed baguette bag
description:
A long, low silhouette gives Reed its understated character. Smooth leather, elongated twin handles and pointed handle attachments create a clean line against everyday layers. A paired zip opening follows the top of the bag, while an internal phone pocket gives a small essential its own place.

Choose Black, Coffee or Wine Red. The quiet shape moves easily from a simple daytime outfit to an evening look.
